shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright stone block/pillar
horizontal band or register dividing the carved surface
raised outline relief with plain background
justification: Both are monolithic upright stones bearing shallow, outlined low relief organised into horizontal registers, with profile creatures worked onto a flat vertical face — that is the most specific correspondence. But A is an anthropomorphic figure whose carvings are largely abstract/geometric (concentric discs, banded chevrons, a sculpted head), while B's reliefs are naturalistic quadruped and bird-like animals on an architectural pillar in situ, so the subject matter and carving manner diverge sharply.
